subject: Visibility package: retention/tracing surcharge structure & concession request
messages:
From: Tom Riddle <t.riddle@auroraai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@auroraai.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Visibility add-ons — retention bands / tracing cost question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the live tracing and dashboard drilldowns look great. Before we formalize a pilot, we need to understand the incremental cost profile for the observability add-ons: retention beyond 30 days, per-trace ingestion surcharges, and the advanced dashboard seats. In particular:

- What does the pricing step-up look like at 60/90/180 days for the retention bucket?
- How are tracing egress/sampling surcharges applied — flat per-MB or token-based?
- Are there any discounts or credits for committed usage across retention+tracing?

We expect sustained traffic for the pilot that will exceed the free retention slab and would like to budget for month 1 vs month 6. Can you send a short breakdown and any options for a pilot discount / one-time credit? We may need a short SOW for procurement.

Best,
Tom
CTO, Aurora AI
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riddle <t.riddle@auroraai.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@auroraai.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention bands / tracing cost question

Tom — great to hear the demo was useful. Short answer: we surface two levers you can mix and match (retention tiers + trace sampling / egress tiers), plus seat-based pricing for advanced dashboards. Details below and attached a simplified spreadsheet.

Retention (per-GB stored/month after the free 30d slab):
- 60d: $0.045/GB/mo (slab pricing)
- 90d: $0.068/GB/mo
- 180d: $0.105/GB/mo

Tracing/ingestion:
- Default: 0.8 ¢/trace (~token-prox) with 95% sample discount when sampling >75%
- Egress-heavy workflows (raw export): additional $0.02/MB

Advanced dashboards: $18/user/mo for read+query seats; $55/user/mo for editor seats (volume discounts at 50+ seats).

Pilot options we can offer:
- 40% one-time credit on retention charges for months 1–3 (pilot only)
- Waive onboarding fee (normally $8k) if you commit to a 6-month Dedicated trial or sign a pilot SOW
- Optional meter-based cap so you don’t exceed budget in the first 60 days (we can auto-throttle)

I attached rwi-visibility-pricing-breakdown.xlsx and a draft SOW (SOW-Aurora-2027-v2.pdf). If you prefer, we can sketch an amortized estimate for month 1 vs month 6.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@auroraai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Riddle <t.riddle@auroraai.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention bands / tracing cost question

Thanks Soojin — that spreadsheet helps. A few follow-ups:

1) The 40% one-time credit — is that refundable if we convert to a full contract, or is it strictly pilot-only?
2) We expect peaks with spikes of raw exports; can you confirm if the $0.02/MB applies to both streaming and batch exports?
3) Procurement will likely ask for a capped pilot spend; is there an easy way to show month-by-month worst-case pricing?

Also, procurement needs the SOW to include a short clause around data retention controls and the ability to delete samples on request. Can you add that to the SOW?

—Aisha
Head of Platform Ops, Aurora AI
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@auroraai.com>, Tom Riddle <t.riddle@auroraai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention bands / tracing cost question

Aisha — quick answers and next steps; looping in Karthik (pricing lead) and Laura (solutions/contract) to finalize language.

1) Credit treatment: pilot credit is applied as a one-time bill credit against the first 3 months of retention charges. If you convert to a paid contract within 90 days we can convert up to 50% of that credit into a contract-level rebate (applied to month 1 of the new term). Full conversion needs manager approval.

2) $0.02/MB applies to both streaming and batch raw exports. We can exclude internal dashboard queries from that metric — only raw export payloads count.

3) Worst-case budgeting: attach an amortized worst-case estimate (high-traffic scenario) in the spreadsheet and we can publish a capped pilot budget in the SOW with an alert threshold at 70% consumption. If you want absolute hard-stop gating we'll need a short ops playbook to handle throttles.

SOW notes: Laura — can you add the deletion/control clause and a sentence about sampling retention policy? Karthik — can you confirm the rebate/conversion language and authorize the 50% convert for this CRO motion?

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Riddle <t.riddle@auroraai.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@auroraai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention bands / tracing cost question

Soojin/Laura — I reviewed the ask. Approve the following concession for Aurora AI to close the pilot this month:

- 40% one-time credit on retention charges for months 1–3 (pilot) — APPROVED
- Convertibility: up to 50% of that credit can be applied as a contract rebate if Aurora signs a 12-month Dedicated or Hosted commitment within 90 days — APPROVED
- Waive onboarding fee ($8k) if a Commitment Letter is signed for a minimum of 6 months — APPROVED

Limits: these concessions are one-off and tied to deal_id RWI-2027-0987. No other add-on discounts will be bundled without revenue/commitment uplift. Laura, please add standard conversion language to the SOW and include a capped pilot spend clause.

Karthik
Head of Price & Packaging | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riddle <t.riddle@auroraai.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@auroraai.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — retention bands / tracing cost question

Tom/Aisha — attaching the updated SOW and a short pilot rider. Highlights:

- Pilot term: 3 months starting on activation date.
- Concessions: 40% credit applied to retention charges months 1–3; 50% convertibility clause if a 12-month commitment is executed within 90 days.
- Capped spend: Pilot capped at $25,000 total; alerts at 70% and 90%. If cap is breached, services will be paused pending written approval.
- Data controls: right-to-delete clause and sample deletion SLA (72 hours) included.

Please confirm if the cap and deletion SLA are acceptable and I will publish the DocuSign envelope. Once we have signature we will provision a pilot cluster and enable the retention sampling thresholds.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Aurora-2027-v2.pdf, rwi-visibility-pricing-breakdown.xlsx
